# Lemonteed AI Access Policy

Lemonteed permits human browsing and traditional search indexing.

Automated AI access is restricted.

The following uses are not permitted without written permission or an active paid license:

- AI model training
- Retrieval-augmented generation ingestion
- Embedding/indexing Lemonteed content into vector databases
- Automated summarization for commercial tools
- Dataset creation
- Content republishing
- Agentic scraping
- Bulk extraction of pages, posts, assets, or structured site data
- Competitive analysis datasets
- Commercial reuse of Lemonteed content

Licensed access may be requested here:

https://lemonteed.com/ai-access

Full AI license terms:

https://lemonteed.com/ai-license

Contact:

Use the contact method provided on the AI Access page.
